title: Rebuilding through reproduction: why restarting circulation determines the return of advanced manufacturing

detail.title: Rebuilding through reproduction: why restarting circulation determines the return of advanced manufacturing
detail.abstract: Why is participation in frontier manufacturing so difficult to regain once it has shifted elsewhere? Conventional explanations emphasize investment, institutional reform, or technological acquisition. This paper proposes a different perspective. Advanced industrial capability depends on the density of environments in which production, diagnosis, suppliers, and design repeatedly adjust to one another. When such circulation thins, erosion can proceed even while expertise and resources remain visible. The argument develops a framework of capability reproduction that shifts attention from possession to renewal. Using the recent attempt by Japan to rebuild leading-edge semiconductor fabrication through Rapidus, the paper traces how historical relocation of high-intensity iteration weakened domestic synchronization across domains. Revival, therefore, requires not only installing equipment or mobilizing talent, but reconstructing the feedback structures that make learning cumulative. This approach clarifies why rebuilding is characterized by complementarity, simultaneity problems, and thresholds. Below a critical interaction density, progress fragments; above it, improvement accelerates. By conceptualizing reindustrialization as a challenge of restarting circulation, the paper offers a processual account of why outcomes remain uncertain despite large-scale commitment. The contribution extends debates on industrial policy, global production networks, and innovation systems by identifying the micro-dynamics through which renewal becomes possible.

AI.tldr: 本文提出前沿制造能力重建困难的新解释：能力依赖生产、诊断、供应商和设计之间持续互动的密度环境。当这种循环减弱，即使专业知识仍在，能力也会侵蚀。重建需要重构反馈结构，而非仅安装设备或动员人才。
AI.research_question: 为什么前沿制造能力一旦转移就难以重建？
AI.motivation: 传统解释强调投资、制度改革或技术获取，但未能充分解释为何即使拥有资源和专业知识，重建仍如此困难。本文提出需要理解能力再生产的微观动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能力再生产框架，将焦点从"拥有"转向"更新"。强调互动密度、反馈结构和循环的重要性。
AI.method: 案例研究：分析日本通过Rapidus重建领先半导体制造的尝试，追溯历史迁移如何削弱国内跨领域同步。
AI.findings: 能力侵蚀发生在互动循环减弱时，即使专业知识仍可见。重建面临互补性、同步性和阈值问题。低于临界互动密度，进步碎片化；高于该密度，改进加速。
AI.theory_contributions: 为产业政策、全球生产网络和创新系统辩论提供微观动态视角，概念化再工业化作为重启循环的挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出重建需要重构反馈结构而不仅仅是安装设备，帮助政策制定者理解为何大规模承诺下结果仍不确定。

title: How Do Chinese Firms Reconfigure under U.S. Export Controls? Strategic Pathways and Constraints

detail.title: How Do Chinese Firms Reconfigure under U.S. Export Controls? Strategic Pathways and Constraints

keywords: export controls·Strategic reconfiguration·Global value chains·Geopolitical risk·Firm heterogeneity·Chinese firms

detail.abstract: Amid rising geopolitical tensions, this study examines how firms reconfigure strategic pathways in response to targeted U.S. export control sanctions. Using a firm year panel of Chinese listed companies from 2013 to 2023, we exploit the staggered timing of U.S. Entity List designations and estimate treatment effects with a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) design. We conceptualize firm responses as constrained choices among three strategic paths: continued global value chains (GVC) persistence, external diversification through rerouting, and internal substitution through localization and capability building. To measure these strategic states, we develop a conduct disclosure framework that integrates theory guided classification with natural language processing (NLP) of annual reports and complementary narrative indicators. The results show that sanctions significantly increase the likelihood that affected firms shift away from GVC persistence, with a stronger shift toward internal substitution than external diversification. These effects are heterogeneous and moderated by financial slack and domestic supply chain embeddedness. Overall, our findings indicate that sanctions operate less by causing immediate disruption and more by systematically reshaping the feasibility and payoffs of alternative strategic pathways. A triple differences (DDD) test further suggests that China’s concurrent “Little Giants” policy does not confound the estimated sanction effects.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用2013-2023年中国上市公司面板数据，分析美国实体清单制裁如何影响企业战略路径重构。研究发现制裁显著促使企业从全球价值链持续转向内部替代（本土化和能力建设），而非外部多元化。财务缓冲和国内供应链嵌入度调节这一效应。
AI.research_question: 美国出口管制制裁如何影响企业重构战略路径？企业面临制裁时在三种战略路径（全球价值链持续、外部多元化、内部替代）中如何选择？
AI.motivation: 地缘政治紧张局势加剧，美国针对中国企业的出口管制制裁日益增多，但企业如何应对这些制裁、如何重构战略路径尚不明确，需要系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于约束选择理论，将企业应对制裁的战略路径概念化为三种：全球价值链持续、外部多元化（重新路由）、内部替代（本土化和能力建设）。
AI.method: 使用2013-2023年中国上市公司面板数据，采用交错双重差分法（staggered DID）分析美国实体清单制裁的效应。开发行为披露框架，结合理论指导分类和自然语言处理分析年报及补充叙事指标。使用三重差分法（DDD）排除中国"小巨人"政策的干扰。
AI.findings: 制裁显著增加受影响企业放弃全球价值链持续的可能性，转向内部替代的效应强于外部多元化。财务缓冲和国内供应链嵌入度调节这些效应。制裁主要通过系统性重塑替代战略路径的可行性和回报来发挥作用，而非立即造成破坏。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出企业应对制裁的战略路径分类框架；2) 开发整合理论分类和NLP的行为披露测量方法；3) 揭示制裁如何系统性重塑战略路径选择而非仅造成即时破坏。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为企业提供应对制裁的战略选择框架；2) 识别财务缓冲和供应链嵌入度的调节作用，为企业资源分配提供指导；3) 为政策制定者理解制裁的实际影响提供实证依据。

title: Differentiable Graph Neural Architecture Search Guided by Dynamic Relation Perception and Sparse Regularization
affiliations: Lanzhou Jiaotong University, Lanzhou Jiaotong University and Lanzhou Jiaotong University

detail.title: Differentiable Graph Neural Architecture Search Guided by Dynamic Relation Perception and Sparse Regularization
detail.abstract: Addressing the critical limitations in current relation search spaces - their inability to model dynamic relation strengths adaptively due to reliance on static operation pools, and the lack of explicit architectural parameter redundancy constraints in conventional differentiable graph neural architecture search (NAS) approaches - we propose a Differentiable Graph Neural Architecture Search Guided by Dynamic Relation Perception and Sparse Regularization (DGNAS-RS) method. Firstly, we design a dynamic convolutional layer integrated into the relation feature update process. which employs basis vector decomposition to extract critical feature representations and employs an attention mechanism for weighted fusion. Secondly, during the architecture search process, we propose an adaptive control mechanism that dynamically adjusts sparse regularization coefficients guided by gradient information to achieve efficient parameter pruning. The proposed method achieves an overall classification accuracy of 95.2% in the 3D point cloud recognition task on the ModelNet10 dataset, an F1 score of 0.869 in the link prediction task on the TSP dataset, a Mean Absolute Error (MAE) of 0.148 in the graph regression task on the ZINC dataset, and an overall classification accuracy of 74.39% in the graph classification task on the CIFAR10 dataset. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms existing methods across multiple graph tasks, validating the effectiveness of the dynamic relation-aware mechanism and the sparse regularization strategy in enhancing both model expressiveness and search efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DGNAS-RS方法，通过动态关系感知和稀疏正则化改进图神经网络架构搜索，在多个图任务上取得优异性能。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够自适应建模动态关系强度并有效控制参数冗余的图神经网络架构搜索方法？
AI.motivation: 当前关系搜索空间存在两个关键限制：1）依赖静态操作池无法自适应建模动态关系强度；2）传统可微分图神经网络架构搜索方法缺乏显式的架构参数冗余约束。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于可微分神经网络架构搜索（NAS）、动态关系感知机制和稀疏正则化理论。
AI.method: 提出DGNAS-RS方法：1）设计动态卷积层，通过基向量分解提取关键特征表示，使用注意力机制进行加权融合；2）在架构搜索过程中，提出自适应控制机制，基于梯度信息动态调整稀疏正则化系数以实现高效参数剪枝。
AI.findings: 在ModelNet10数据集上3D点云识别任务达到95.2%分类准确率，TSP数据集链接预测任务F1分数0.869，ZINC数据集图回归任务MAE为0.148，CIFAR10数据集图分类任务达到74.39%准确率。实验结果表明该方法在多个图任务上优于现有方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出动态关系感知机制，解决静态操作池无法自适应建模动态关系强度的问题；2）提出基于梯度信息的自适应稀疏正则化策略，有效控制架构搜索中的参数冗余。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）DGNAS-RS方法在多个图学习任务上实现性能提升；2）为图神经网络架构搜索提供了一种高效且可解释的解决方案；3）代码实现可作为相关研究的基准方法。

title: Listed company digital transformation, ESG performance and carbon emissions reduction
affiliations: Hunan University of Finance and Economics and Hunan Agricultural University

detail.title: Listed company digital transformation, ESG performance and carbon emissions reduction
detail.abstract: This study selects data from A-share listed companies from 2010 to 2023 as a sample to empirically examine the impact of corporate digital transformation on carbon emissions and the mediating role of ESG performance. The research finds that corporate digital transformation can significantly optimize production and operation processes, enhance resource utilization efficiency, and strengthen environmental governance capabilities, thereby effectively reducing corporate carbon emission levels. This effect is particularly prominent in eastern regions, high-tech enterprises, and enterprises with high growth potential. At the same time, enterprises advancing digital transformation are conducive to improving their comprehensive performance in environmental, social, and governance (ESG) aspects, which in turn further inhibits carbon emissions through ESG mechanisms. Therefore, enterprises should deepen their digital transformation strategies and promote the integration of digital technology with green production; government departments should improve carbon emission reduction incentives and constraints policies, guiding enterprises to achieve low-carbon transformation through digitalization and ESG practices.

AI.tldr: 本研究以2010-2023年A股上市公司为样本，实证检验企业数字化转型对碳排放的影响及ESG绩效的中介作用。研究发现数字化转型能优化生产运营、提升资源利用效率、增强环境治理能力，从而降低碳排放，且在东部地区、高科技企业和高成长性企业中效果更显著。同时，数字化转型通过提升ESG综合绩效进一步抑制碳排放。
AI.research_question: 企业数字化转型如何影响碳排放？ESG绩效在这一关系中起什么中介作用？
AI.motivation: 随着全球气候变化问题日益严峻，企业碳减排成为重要议题。数字化转型作为企业现代化发展的重要路径，可能通过优化生产运营、提升资源效率等方式影响碳排放，但具体机制尚需实证检验。同时，ESG作为衡量企业可持续发展的重要框架，可能在数字化转型与碳排放之间起中介作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于资源基础理论、技术创新理论和可持续发展理论，探讨数字化转型如何通过优化资源配置、提升生产效率、增强环境治理能力等路径影响碳排放。同时结合ESG理论框架，分析环境、社会和治理绩效在数字化转型与碳排放关系中的中介机制。
AI.method: 采用2010-2023年A股上市公司面板数据，构建计量经济模型，运用固定效应模型或随机效应模型进行回归分析。通过中介效应检验方法验证ESG绩效的中介作用，并进行异质性分析（地区、行业、企业特征等）。
AI.findings: 1. 企业数字化转型显著降低碳排放水平；2. 数字化转型通过优化生产运营流程、提高资源利用效率、增强环境治理能力三条路径实现碳减排；3. 东部地区、高科技企业和高成长性企业的碳减排效果更明显；4. ESG绩效在数字化转型与碳排放关系中起部分中介作用；5. 数字化转型通过提升ESG综合绩效进一步抑制碳排放。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 拓展了数字化转型理论在环境治理领域的应用；2. 揭示了数字化转型影响碳排放的多重路径机制；3. 验证了ESG绩效在数字化转型与碳排放关系中的中介作用；4. 丰富了企业可持续发展理论框架；5. 为技术创新与环境治理的协同发展提供理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业制定数字化转型战略提供碳减排视角的指导；2. 建议企业将数字化技术与绿色生产深度融合；3. 为政府制定差异化碳减排政策提供依据；4. 建议政府完善激励约束机制，引导企业通过数字化和ESG实践实现低碳转型；5. 为投资者评估企业环境绩效提供参考框架。

title: Do Poverty Alleviation Policies Enhance Household Resilience to Poverty? Evidence from Bangladesh
affiliations: The University of Manchester - Department of Economics, Cornell University - Charles H. Dyson School of Applied Economics and Management and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Do Poverty Alleviation Policies Enhance Household Resilience to Poverty? Evidence from Bangladesh
detail.abstract: We investigate whether traditional poverty alleviation policies, typically designed for immediate poverty reduction, also enhance households' resilience to future unexpected shocks. We revisit a randomized control trial in Bangladesh which undertook a two year intervention across two rural regions of Bangladesh. Using an improved resilience metric and machine learning methods, we present new findings of the impact of the different poverty alleviation strategies, both at the endline and four years post intervention. Our study reveals that poverty alleviation interventions, such as unconditional cash transfers, and cash or food transfers combined with intensive group-based behavior change communication (BCC), significantly improve resilience compared to pure in-kind transfers. However, these policies are primarily effective in strengthening resilience to extreme poverty. Four years after the intervention, we find some evidence of cash transfers enhancing resilience to extreme poverty. We explain our findings through both short-term coping strategies and long-term adaptive mechanisms.\

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨传统扶贫政策是否增强家庭对未来意外冲击的抵御能力。通过孟加拉国的随机对照试验发现，无条件现金转移以及现金/食品转移结合行为改变沟通能显著提升抵御极端贫困的韧性，而纯实物转移效果较差。
AI.research_question: 传统扶贫政策（通常为即时减贫设计）是否也能增强家庭对未来意外冲击的抵御能力？
AI.motivation: 现有扶贫政策主要关注即时减贫效果，但缺乏对家庭长期韧性（抵御未来冲击能力）影响的系统评估，需要填补这一研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 韧性理论（Resilience Theory），区分短期应对策略和长期适应机制，关注极端贫困抵御能力。
AI.method: 采用改进的韧性度量指标和机器学习方法，重新分析孟加拉国农村地区的随机对照试验数据，评估干预结束和干预后四年的效果。
AI.findings: 1. 无条件现金转移、现金/食品转移结合行为改变沟通显著提升韧性；2. 纯实物转移效果较差；3. 政策主要增强对极端贫困的抵御能力；4. 干预后四年，现金转移仍显示对极端贫困韧性的提升效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将韧性概念引入扶贫政策评估框架；2. 区分短期应对和长期适应机制；3. 提供改进的韧性度量方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供证据：现金转移比实物转移更能增强长期韧性；2. 行为改变沟通的附加价值；3. 强调政策设计需考虑长期韧性建设。

title: The Logic-Switch: From Causal Planning to Communal Effectuation among Women Entrepreneurs in the Lebanese Polycrisis
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Logic-Switch: From Causal Planning to Communal Effectuation among Women Entrepreneurs in the Lebanese Polycrisis
detail.abstract: Entrepreneurial decision-making under prolonged and causally entangled disruption remains poorly understood, particularly in gendered, institutionally fragile emerging economies. Drawing on a 16-month participatory action research study with women micro-entrepreneurs in Lebanon, this paper examines how entrepreneurial action is organized when predictive planning repeatedly fails and instability becomes a persistent condition. Findings show that entrepreneurs do not simply shift from causation to effectuation during crisis. Instead, decision-making unfolds through communal effectuation: an embedded governance logic enacted through shared sensemaking, reciprocal buffering of affordable loss, pooled resources, and relational co-creation of market action. Logic-switching emerges as a collectively stabilized practice that regulates when planning is suspended, selectively reintroduced, or retained symbolically for legitimacy. By foregrounding embedded agency and everyday practices rather than individual cognition, the study extends behavioral theories of entrepreneurial decision-making into polycrisis contexts and advances communal effectuation as a durable form of decision logic under chronic uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过参与式行动研究发现，在长期危机中，女性微企业家不是简单地从因果逻辑转向效果逻辑，而是发展出"社群效果逻辑"——一种通过共享意义建构、互惠缓冲、资源汇集和市场行动关系共创的嵌入式治理逻辑。
AI.research_question: 在长期、因果交织的危机环境中，特别是在性别化、制度脆弱的新兴经济体，企业家如何组织行动？当预测性规划反复失败且不稳定成为持久状态时，创业决策如何展开？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对长期、因果交织危机下的创业决策理解不足，特别是在性别化、制度脆弱的新兴经济体中。传统创业决策理论(如因果逻辑与效果逻辑)难以解释在持续不稳定环境中的决策过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业决策理论(因果逻辑与效果逻辑)、嵌入式代理理论、实践理论、意义建构理论、制度理论
AI.method: 16个月的参与式行动研究，研究对象为黎巴嫩的女性微企业家
AI.findings: 1. 企业家在危机中不是简单地从因果逻辑转向效果逻辑；2. 决策通过"社群效果逻辑"展开：一种通过共享意义建构、互惠缓冲可承受损失、汇集资源和关系共创市场行动的嵌入式治理逻辑；3. 逻辑切换成为集体稳定的实践，调节何时暂停规划、选择性重新引入规划或象征性保留规划以获取合法性
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将创业决策的行为理论扩展到多重危机情境；2. 提出"社群效果逻辑"作为长期不确定性下的持久决策逻辑；3. 强调嵌入式代理和日常实践而非个体认知；4. 揭示逻辑切换作为集体稳定实践的重要性
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为在长期危机中运营的企业家提供实用的决策框架；2. 强调社群合作和资源共享在危机应对中的重要性；3. 为政策制定者支持脆弱环境中的女性企业家提供见解；4. 展示集体行动在维持创业活动中的作用

title: Evaluating a tailored communication tool to increase advance care planning among Alaska Native and American Indian people in primary care: A type 1 hybrid effectiveness-implementation cluster randomized trial protocol
affiliations: University of Alaska Fairbanks, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Arkansas for Medical Sciences

detail.title: Evaluating a tailored communication tool to increase advance care planning among Alaska Native and American Indian people in primary care: A type 1 hybrid effectiveness-implementation cluster randomized trial protocol
detail.abstract: The older Alaska Native/American Indian (AN/AI) population is increasing faster than their U.S. peers overall. However, AN/AI peoples are less likely to receive palliative care, including advance care planning (ACP). ACP leads to better outcomes for patients, their families, and health systems, including decreased depression, anxiety, and grief, fewer non-beneficial end-of-life treatments, and reduced cost. ACP is typically documented in advance directives that specify patient preferences for life-sustaining treatments and who can make medical decisions on their behalf. AN/AI peoples are as likely as non-AN/AI peoples to utilize palliative care when it is culturally tailored. Therefore, there is an urgent need for strategies to provide tailored palliative and end-of-life care interventions for AN/AI people. Our team used community engagement methods to tailor an ACP communication intervention and pilot the tailored intervention—Jumpstart—with seriously ill adult AN/AI peoples within a Tribal health system. Most (95%) of patients in the pilot stated that Jumpstart helped them to have ACP conversations with their primary care providers. The current study uses a type 1 hybrid effectiveness-implementation randomized controlled trial to examine the effectiveness of a tailored ACP intervention and evaluate implementation variables. This study will provide critical evidence for improving care for seriously ill AN/AI peoples and their families.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对阿拉斯加原住民/美洲印第安人(AN/AI)群体，开发并测试了文化定制的临终关怀沟通干预措施"Jumpstart"，通过社区参与方法设计，并在部落卫生系统中进行试点和随机对照试验评估。
AI.research_question: 文化定制的临终关怀沟通干预措施"Jumpstart"是否能有效提高严重疾病的阿拉斯加原住民/美洲印第安人(AN/AI)群体的临终关怀参与度？
AI.motivation: AN/AI老年人口增长速度快于美国整体水平，但该群体接受临终关怀（包括临终关怀计划）的可能性较低。虽然文化定制的临终关怀服务能提高AN/AI人群的参与度，但目前缺乏针对性的干预策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社区参与式研究方法，强调文化定制在医疗干预中的重要性，以及临终关怀计划对患者、家庭和医疗系统的多重益处。
AI.method: 采用1型混合有效性-实施随机对照试验设计，先通过社区参与方法开发文化定制的干预措施"Jumpstart"，在部落卫生系统中进行试点，然后通过随机对照试验评估干预效果和实施变量。
AI.findings: 试点研究中95%的患者表示"Jumpstart"帮助他们与初级保健提供者进行了临终关怀对话。当前研究正在进行随机对照试验以评估干预效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 为文化定制医疗干预的理论框架提供实证支持，特别是在少数民族群体的临终关怀领域，强调社区参与在干预设计中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了针对AN/AI人群的文化定制临终关怀沟通工具"Jumpstart"，为部落卫生系统提供可行的干预方案，有望改善严重疾病AN/AI患者及其家庭的医疗照护质量。

title: Lost connections: The Economic and Social Consequences of Early-life Mental Health
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University, Abu Dhabi, University of Aberdeen, New York University (NYU) - New York University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Lost connections: The Economic and Social Consequences of Early-life Mental Health
detail.abstract: We investigate how mental health during COVID—specifically anxiety and depression—is associated with multifaceted outcomes among young adults: economic status, social connectedness, and life satisfaction. Utilizing unique longitudinal data collected in Kasur, Pakistan, we find that past anxiety, but not past depression, is associated with current social connectedness and, to a lesser extent, over- all life satisfaction while economic status remains unaffected. This aligns with a “standardized” life course framework where youth trajectories regarding economic status may follow a predetermined course. We support this framework by demonstrating that (i) economic status in our data is indeed very standard, mirroring the distribution of economic status in Pakistan Social and Living Standards Measurement (PSLM) data; (ii) parents are the primary decision makers as parental characteristics drive economic outcomes more than youth traits; and (iii) young adults have limited autonomy, especially in households with high parental authority suppressing the influence of mental health. The association of past anxiety with social connectedness and overall life satisfaction during young adult-hood informs policymakers in supporting interventions that would break cycles of isolation.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了COVID期间心理健康（焦虑和抑郁）对巴基斯坦青年经济状况、社会联系和生活满意度的影响。研究发现，过去的焦虑（而非抑郁）与当前社会联系和整体生活满意度相关，但经济状况不受影响，这符合"标准化"生命历程框架。
AI.research_question: COVID期间的心理健康（焦虑和抑郁）如何影响青年成年人的经济状况、社会联系和生活满意度？
AI.motivation: 了解COVID大流行期间心理健康问题对青年长期发展的多方面影响，特别是在巴基斯坦这样的发展中国家背景下，为制定针对性干预政策提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: "标准化"生命历程框架，认为青年的经济轨迹可能遵循预定路径，受父母决策和家庭结构影响较大，而心理健康对经济结果的影响有限。
AI.method: 使用巴基斯坦卡苏尔地区的独特纵向数据，分析过去焦虑和抑郁与当前经济状况、社会联系和生活满意度的关联。
AI.findings: 1. 过去的焦虑（而非抑郁）与当前社会联系和整体生活满意度相关；2. 经济状况不受过去心理健康影响；3. 经济状况分布与PSLM数据一致，显示标准化特征；4. 父母是主要决策者，父母特征比青年特质更能预测经济结果；5. 青年自主权有限，高父母权威家庭中心理健康影响更弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了"标准化"生命历程框架在发展中国家青年发展研究中的适用性，强调了家庭结构和代际关系在塑造青年经济轨迹中的核心作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据：应关注焦虑对社会联系和生活满意度的长期影响，设计干预措施打破孤立循环，特别是在父母权威较强的家庭环境中。

title: Improving GDP Nowcasting Using Fiscal Variables: Evidence from a Dynamic Factor Model

detail.title: Improving GDP Nowcasting Using Fiscal Variables: Evidence from a Dynamic Factor Model
detail.abstract: While traditional literature tends to exclude fiscal data from GDP nowcasting, this study argues that standard models fail to fully capture the growth impulse generated by unprecedented public budget expansions. To address this gap, the work compares an adapted specification of the New York Fed Staff Nowcast against an augmented model that incorporates three federal fiscal indicators. The analysis, conducted on a reconstruction of real-time vintages from 2017 to 2025, highlights a systematic improvement in accuracy metrics for the fiscal-enhanced model. Specifically, the fiscal signal becomes predominant in two distinct circumstances: during the second-quarter tax season and throughout the post-pandemic period. This work contributes to the literature by demonstrating the necessity of adapting DFM nowcasting models to the new centrality of fiscal policy.

AI.tldr: 该研究挑战了传统GDP即时预测中排除财政数据的做法，通过将联邦财政指标纳入模型，发现在特定时期（第二季度税收季和疫情后）财政信号显著提升预测准确性。
AI.research_question: 在GDP即时预测中，纳入财政数据是否能系统性地提高预测准确性？特别是在公共预算空前扩张的背景下，财政信号何时对预测最为重要？
AI.motivation: 传统文献倾向于在GDP即时预测中排除财政数据，但标准模型未能充分捕捉前所未有的公共预算扩张所产生的增长动力。在财政政策重要性日益凸显的新背景下，需要重新评估财政数据在预测模型中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态因子模型（DFM）框架下的即时预测理论，特别是纽约联储员工即时预测模型的扩展版本。研究基于财政政策在宏观经济预测中重要性的理论认识。
AI.method: 比较分析：将适应的纽约联储员工即时预测模型与增强版模型（纳入三个联邦财政指标）进行对比。使用2017年至2025年实时数据重构进行分析，评估准确性指标的改进。
AI.findings: 财政增强模型在准确性指标上显示出系统性改进。财政信号在两种特定情况下变得尤为突出：1）第二季度税收季期间；2）整个疫情后时期。这表明在财政政策重要性提升的新环境下，需要调整DFM即时预测模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明在财政政策重要性日益凸显的新背景下，需要调整动态因子模型（DFM）即时预测框架以纳入财政数据。为财政政策在宏观经济预测中的作用提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和预测者提供了改进GDP即时预测的具体方法：在税收季和财政扩张时期特别关注财政指标。增强了在财政政策主导时期的经济预测准确性。

title: Cultural Contexts: Witchcraft Accusations, Gender Realities, And Local Insights in India
affiliations: Staffordshire University, UK and REVA University

detail.title: Cultural Contexts: Witchcraft Accusations, Gender Realities, And Local Insights in India
detail.abstract: This paper provides an analysis of the intersection of harmful practices associated with witchcraft within India's socio-cultural landscape, revealing how discussions on witchcraft accusations are shaped by caste, gender, and religion. Witchcraft spans various disciplines, but its global prevalence and ambiguous nature pose challenges in terminology, definition, identification, and understanding. This paper explores possible definitions, initially examining the terminology linked with witchcraft to establish a clear working definition. Subsequently, the paper delves into the nature of witchcraft beliefs within the society, exploring the origins and mechanics of the witchcraft discourse. Identifying the nature of witchcraft beliefs within society is crucial, as it forms the foundation for interpreting the phenomenon and understanding its ramifications on women. Lastly, the paper seeks to evaluate the repercussions of witchcraftrelated violence on women in India. The authors highlight the importance of societal transformation to combat gender stereotypes, advocating for stringent legislation recognizing harmful practices as severe crimes and amending existing laws for effective implementation in pluralistic contexts. They stress the need for awareness at local levels regarding human rights violations against women and legislation prohibiting such practices to break free from entrenched gender biases.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印度巫术相关有害实践与社会文化背景的交集，揭示了种姓、性别和宗教如何塑造巫术指控的讨论。论文探讨了巫术的定义、社会中的巫术信仰本质，以及巫术相关暴力对印度女性的影响，强调需要通过社会变革、立法和意识提升来应对这一问题。
AI.research_question: 印度社会中巫术相关有害实践如何受到种姓、性别和宗教的影响？巫术信仰的本质是什么？巫术相关暴力对女性造成了哪些后果？
AI.motivation: 巫术在全球普遍存在但定义模糊，在印度社会中与种姓、性别和宗教交织，导致对女性的暴力侵害。需要澄清术语、理解社会信仰基础，并评估对女性的影响，以制定有效干预措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交叉性理论（种姓、性别、宗教的交织影响），社会建构理论（巫术话语的社会建构），性别暴力理论，法律与社会变革理论。
AI.method: 概念分析（术语定义探讨），话语分析（巫术话语的起源和机制），社会文化分析（信仰体系考察），影响评估（暴力后果分析）。
AI.findings: 1. 巫术讨论在印度被种姓、性别和宗教因素塑造；2. 巫术信仰根植于社会文化结构中；3. 巫术相关暴力对女性造成严重伤害；4. 现有法律在多元文化背景下实施效果有限。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了印度语境下巫术的交叉性分析框架；2. 阐明了巫术话语的社会建构机制；3. 扩展了性别暴力理论在传统文化实践中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 呼吁制定更严格的法律将有害实践定为严重犯罪；2. 建议修改现有法律以适应多元文化实施；3. 强调基层人权意识提升的重要性；4. 提出社会变革需要打破根深蒂固的性别偏见。

title: Is Iraq Next After Iran? Dual Loyalties and the Making of a Proxy State

detail.title: Is Iraq Next After Iran? Dual Loyalties and the Making of a Proxy State

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known personal, professional, or financial relationships that could be perceived as influencing the research presented in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve clinical trials, medical interventions, or experiments on human participants. Where illustrative case material or lived-experience references are used, they are presented in an anonymized, non-identifiable manner and for analytical purposes only. No formal ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency, commercial entity, or not-for-profit organization. The study was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: This article examines the growing risk of Iraq’s transformation into a proxy state amid escalating regional tensions and renewed patterns of recycled political power. Moving beyond individual actors, it analyzes dual loyalty as a structural condition that undermines sovereignty, institutional legitimacy, and social cohesion. Drawing on documented political phases since 2003, the article links sectarian governance, protest movements, economic decline, and mass migration to a broader regional context shaped by proxy networks and external bargaining. The analysis argues that Iraq’s instability is not accidental, but the outcome of a persistent governance model that prioritizes leverage over statehood. The article concludes by assessing the human and political costs of proxy rule and the narrowing window for reclaiming sovereign, accountable governance.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了伊拉克在地区紧张局势升级和权力循环模式下，如何面临成为代理国家的风险。文章认为伊拉克的不稳定并非偶然，而是优先考虑外部杠杆而非国家建设的治理模式的必然结果。
AI.research_question: 伊拉克如何面临转变为代理国家的风险？这种转变的结构性条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 随着地区紧张局势升级和政治权力循环模式重现，伊拉克面临成为代理国家的风险日益增长，这威胁到国家主权、制度合法性和社会凝聚力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理国家理论、双重忠诚的结构性条件分析、主权侵蚀理论、制度合法性理论
AI.method: 基于2003年以来的政治阶段文献分析，将教派治理、抗议运动、经济衰退和大众移民与更广泛的地区代理网络和外部谈判背景联系起来
AI.findings: 伊拉克的不稳定并非偶然，而是优先考虑外部杠杆而非国家建设的持久治理模式的结果；双重忠诚作为结构性条件破坏了主权、制度合法性和社会凝聚力
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了双重忠诚作为结构性条件的分析框架，将代理国家理论与具体政治实践联系起来，深化了对主权侵蚀机制的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 评估了代理统治的人力和政治成本，指出了恢复主权和问责治理的紧迫性，为政策制定者提供了关于伊拉克治理模式风险的分析

title: Government Debt and Productivity: Evidence from A Non-Gaussian SVAR Model for Finland

detail.title: Government Debt and Productivity: Evidence from A Non-Gaussian SVAR Model for Finland
detail.abstract: This paper studies the effects of public debt on private investment and productivity using a statistically identified Bayesian SVAR. Identification is achieved through non-Gaussian features of the data, while sign restrictions are used solely to label economically meaningful shocks. Using Finnish data, we isolate an unanticipated debt shock and examine its dynamic effects on corporate investment, productivity, and financing conditions. We find that an increase in public debt leads to a persistent decline in private investment and corporate-sector productivity, accompanied by a rise in government bond spreads, consistent with a crowding-out mechanism. Robustness checks across alternative horizons and lag specifications support the uniqueness and stability of the identified debt shock. By addressing recent critiques of sign-based identification, the paper provides new evidence on the medium-term channels through which public debt can affect economic growth.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用芬兰数据，通过贝叶斯SVAR模型识别公共债务冲击，发现公共债务增加会导致私人投资和企业生产率持续下降，符合挤出效应机制。
AI.research_question: 公共债务对私人投资和生产率有何影响？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 公共债务对经济增长的影响是宏观经济政策的重要议题，但现有研究在识别债务冲击方面存在方法学挑战，特别是基于符号限制的识别方法受到批评。
AI.theoretical_framework: 挤出效应理论（crowding-out mechanism），即公共债务增加会提高政府债券利差，从而挤出私人投资。
AI.method: 使用统计识别的贝叶斯结构向量自回归（SVAR），通过数据的非高斯特征进行识别，仅使用符号限制来标记经济上有意义的冲击。
AI.findings: 公共债务增加会导致私人投资和企业部门生产率持续下降，同时政府债券利差上升，这与挤出效应机制一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过改进识别方法（使用非高斯特征而非仅依赖符号限制），为公共债务影响经济增长的中期渠道提供了新证据，回应了近期对基于符号识别方法的批评。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于公共债务对私人投资和生产率负面影响的实证证据，强调了控制公共债务水平的重要性。

title: Socio-hydrological interactions affect the health of drought-prone rural communities in Brazil
affiliations: Wageningen University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, PETRAN, Federal Institute of Education Science and Technology of Ceara, Federal University of Ceara, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Wageningen University

detail.title: Socio-hydrological interactions affect the health of drought-prone rural communities in Brazil
detail.abstract: Severe droughts intensify water insecurity and pose significant risks to human health in semi-arid regions, particularly in rural communities with limited access to safe water and sanitation. This study investigates socio-hydrological interactions linking water access, domestic water use, and waterborne diseases in three drought-prone rural communities in the Brazilian semi-arid region. We conducted a cross-sectional mixed-methods study involving 91 families, combining household surveys on water use practices, hygiene habits, and diarrhea occurrence with microbiological analyses of water sources and hydrometeorological assessment using the Standardized Precipitation Index. Results reveal high socioeconomic vulnerability and strong dependence on multiple, often untreated, water sources, including rainwater cisterns, surface reservoirs, wells, and water trucks. Although rainwater cisterns were prioritized for drinking and cooking, most sampled sources showed coliform contamination, while Escherichia coli was detected primarily in reservoir water, water trucks, wells, and some bottled water. The occurrence of diarrhea varied across communities and was associated with source diversity, limited household water treatment, and reliance on higher-risk sources during scarcity. Causal Loop Diagrams highlighted reinforcing feedbacks between drought, water access, household income, and health risks, illustrating how economic constraints shape exposure pathways to waterborne pathogens. The findings underscore the need for integrated approaches that connect water governance, WaSH practices, and public health surveillance to reduce vulnerability and strengthen resilience to drought-related health impacts in semi-arid rural settings.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了巴西半干旱地区三个干旱易发农村社区中水获取、家庭用水与水传播疾病之间的社会水文相互作用，揭示了高社会经济脆弱性、对多种未处理水源的依赖以及腹泻发生率与水源多样性、有限水处理和依赖高风险水源之间的关联。
AI.research_question: 在巴西半干旱地区的干旱易发农村社区中，水获取、家庭用水与水传播疾病之间存在怎样的社会水文相互作用关系？
AI.motivation: 严重干旱加剧了半干旱地区的水不安全，对农村社区的人类健康构成重大风险，特别是那些安全水和卫生设施获取有限的社区。需要理解这些地区的社会水文相互作用以制定有效的干预措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会水文相互作用理论，因果循环图（Causal Loop Diagrams）框架，水安全与健康风险关联理论
AI.method: 横断面混合方法研究，涉及91个家庭，结合家庭调查（用水实践、卫生习惯、腹泻发生）、水源微生物学分析和标准化降水指数的水文气象评估
AI.findings: 1) 社区存在高社会经济脆弱性，依赖多种未处理水源；2) 雨水水箱优先用于饮用和烹饪，但大多数水源显示大肠菌群污染；3) 大肠杆菌主要在水库水、水车、水井和部分瓶装水中检测到；4) 腹泻发生率与水源多样性、有限家庭水处理和干旱期间依赖高风险水源相关；5) 因果循环图揭示了干旱、水获取、家庭收入和健康风险之间的强化反馈循环
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 发展了半干旱农村地区社会水文相互作用的实证理解；2) 展示了经济约束如何塑造水传播病原体暴露途径；3) 提供了干旱、水获取和健康风险之间反馈机制的系统视角
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 强调需要整合水治理、WaSH实践和公共卫生监测的综合方法；2) 为减少干旱相关健康影响的脆弱性和增强韧性提供政策建议；3) 为干旱易发农村社区的水安全干预措施提供实证依据

title: Is Normative Design Possible, Or Is Law Captive to Human Fallibility?

detail.title: Is Normative Design Possible, Or Is Law Captive to Human Fallibility?
detail.abstract: This article critically examines the implicit assumption of the "rational, well-intentioned, and measured decision-maker" underlying modern legal systems. Classical and modern legal theories have largely grounded legal stability in human rationality and moral self-restraint. In contrast, historical experience, behavioral sciences, and political practice demonstrate that individuals exercising authority are predictably prone to systematic deviations, regardless of personal virtue. This reveals that law's fundamental fragility stems not primarily from the content of norms, but from the institutional architecture within which those norms operate. The article argues for reconceptualizing law through a normative design approach that takes human fallibility as a foundational assumption rather than an exception. Within this framework, principles such as the fragmentation of authority, traceability of decision-making, limitation of discretion, and reversibility are analyzed as means of enhancing legal resilience. The concept of normative space is employed to reassess debates on common law and lex mercatoria, while artificial intelligence and algorithmic systems are positioned not as norm-creating agents but as instruments that strengthen normative oversight.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了现代法律体系隐含的"理性、善意、审慎决策者"假设，指出法律的根本脆弱性源于制度架构而非规范内容，主张以人类易错性为基础重构法律设计，通过权力分散、决策可追溯、裁量权限制和可逆性等原则增强法律韧性。
AI.research_question: 如何基于人类易错性这一基本假设，重新构建法律体系以增强其韧性和稳定性？
AI.motivation: 传统法律理论将法律稳定性建立在人类理性和道德自律基础上，但历史经验、行为科学和政治实践表明，行使权力者存在系统性偏差，这揭示了法律的根本脆弱性源于制度架构而非规范内容。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 批判法学理论：挑战"理性决策者"假设；2. 行为法律经济学：揭示系统性认知偏差；3. 制度设计理论：强调架构对规范执行的影响；4. 规范性空间概念：用于分析普通法和商人法。
AI.method: 理论批判与重构方法：通过历史分析、行为科学证据和政治实践观察，批判传统法律假设，提出基于人类易错性的规范性设计框架。
AI.findings: 1. 法律脆弱性主要源于制度架构而非规范内容；2. 人类易错性是普遍规律而非例外；3. 权力分散、决策可追溯、裁量权限制和可逆性等原则能增强法律韧性；4. 人工智能应作为强化规范性监督的工具而非规范创造者。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出基于人类易错性的法律重构理论；2. 发展规范性设计方法；3. 重新概念化法律稳定性来源；4. 为普通法和商人法辩论提供新分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为法律制度改革提供设计原则；2. 指导人工智能在法律体系中的合理定位；3. 增强法律体系应对人类偏差的韧性；4. 为制度设计者提供具体实施框架。

title: A Level of Service Assessment Based Decision Support Model for Drinking Water Systems
affiliations: University of British Columbia Okanagan, University of British Columbia Okanagan, University of British Columbia Okanagan, University of British Columbia (UBC) - School of Engineering and University of British Columbia (UBC) - School of Engineering

detail.title: A Level of Service Assessment Based Decision Support Model for Drinking Water Systems
detail.abstract: Due to aging infrastructure, financial limitations, rapid population growth, and the increasing impacts of climate change on urban infrastructure, especially drinking water systems (DWSs) are under growing pressure. Effective asset management of DWSs requires a clear understanding of assets, their operational functionality, and service performance, which is commonly evaluated through the Level of Service (LOS). This study developed a decision support model to assess the LOS of DWSs through a sustainability lens. The model includes three methodological steps: (i) data collection, (ii) development of an overall LOS, and (iii) LOS assessment for informed decision making. It enables both individual assessments and cross-system comparisons, helping decision makers identify performance gaps and reveal service level disparities among the systems. The proposed model was applied to three selected DWSs in British Columbia, Canada -two large drinking water systems (LDWSs) and one small drinking water system (SDWS)- to demonstrate the utility and relevance of the developed model. The findings highlight the necessity for tailored strategies to improve LOS in SDWS, which experience greater cost pressures as compared to LDWS because of limited treatment capabilities, and lower infrastructure performance. This research will help decision makers to facilitate informed decision making in planning, maintenance, and development of drinking water infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个通过可持续性视角评估饮用水系统服务水平（LOS）的决策支持模型，包含数据收集、总体LOS开发和LOS评估三个步骤，应用于加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省的三个饮用水系统，发现小型系统因处理能力有限和基础设施性能较低而面临更大成本压力，需要定制化策略。
AI.research_question: 如何通过可持续性视角开发一个决策支持模型来评估饮用水系统的服务水平（LOS），以帮助决策者识别性能差距和服务水平差异？
AI.motivation: 由于基础设施老化、财政限制、人口快速增长以及气候变化对城市基础设施（特别是饮用水系统）的影响日益加剧，饮用水系统面临越来越大的压力。有效的资产管理需要对资产、运营功能和服务绩效有清晰了解，而服务水平（LOS）是常用的评估指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于服务水平（LOS）理论和可持续性视角，构建饮用水系统评估框架，将可持续性维度（环境、社会、经济）整合到LOS评估中。
AI.method: 开发了一个三步骤决策支持模型：1）数据收集；2）开发总体LOS指标；3）LOS评估以支持决策制定。该模型应用于加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省的三个饮用水系统（两个大型系统，一个小型系统）进行实证验证。
AI.findings: 研究发现小型饮用水系统（SDWS）相比大型系统（LDWS）面临更大的成本压力，主要由于处理能力有限和基础设施性能较低。研究强调了为小型系统制定定制化策略以改善LOS的必要性。模型能够识别性能差距并揭示系统间的服务水平差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了一个通过可持续性视角评估饮用水系统LOS的综合框架；2）将可持续性维度整合到传统LOS评估中；3）开发了既支持个体评估又支持跨系统比较的方法论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为决策者提供了实用的决策支持工具，帮助识别性能差距和服务水平差异；2）揭示了小型饮用水系统面临的特殊挑战，为制定针对性改进策略提供依据；3）支持饮用水基础设施的规划、维护和发展方面的知情决策。

title: Neuroleadership: Concepts, Methods, Frontier Advances, and Future Agenda ——Systematic literature review on the past 25 years (2000-2024)

detail.title: Neuroleadership: Concepts, Methods, Frontier Advances, and Future Agenda ——Systematic literature review on the past 25 years (2000-2024)
detail.abstract: This article provides a systematic review of the emerging field of “Neuroleadership” with the intersection of neuroscience and leadership studies, by combining related literature published in SSCI journals in the past 25 years(2000-2024). Firstly, the concept and research methods on neuroleadership were summarized, and the advantages and disadvantages between different technologies were compared; Secondly, the relevant research on the localization of brain regions related to leadership behavior was reviewed, and the five major themes of neuroleadership research were summarized and analyzed: the neural mechanisms of leadership traits and genetic characteristics, the neural mechanisms of leadership emotional responses, the neural mechanisms of leadership decision-making behavior, the neural mechanisms of leader subordinate interaction, and the neural mechanisms of leadership training processes; Finally, the research value and future prospects of neuroleadership study were briefly discussed. The research results have important theoretical significance for clarifying the trends of neuroleadership, summarizing academic achievements, and extracting academic problems, promoting the further research agenda.

AI.tldr: 本文对神经领导学领域进行了系统性综述，总结了2000-2024年间SSCI期刊相关文献，梳理了神经领导学的概念、研究方法、脑区定位研究，并分析了五大研究主题，最后讨论了该领域的价值与未来前景。
AI.research_question: 神经领导学领域的研究现状、主要主题、研究方法及未来发展方向是什么？
AI.motivation: 神经科学与领导力研究的交叉领域"神经领导学"正在兴起，但缺乏系统性综述来总结该领域的研究趋势、学术成果和存在问题，需要梳理25年来的文献以推动进一步研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 神经领导学理论框架，整合了神经科学（脑区功能定位、神经机制）与领导力理论（特质理论、情感智力、决策行为、领导-下属互动等）。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述方法，分析2000-2024年间SSCI期刊发表的神经领导学相关文献，包括概念总结、研究方法比较、脑区定位研究回顾和主题分析。
AI.findings: 1. 总结了神经领导学的概念和研究方法，比较了不同技术的优缺点；2. 回顾了领导行为相关脑区定位研究；3. 归纳出五大研究主题：领导特质与遗传特征的神经机制、领导情感反应的神经机制、领导决策行为的神经机制、领导-下属互动的神经机制、领导培训过程的神经机制。

title: Technology Integration, Instructional Alignment, and Student Engagement in Project-Based Entrepreneurship Education
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Durban University of Technology

detail.title: Technology Integration, Instructional Alignment, and Student Engagement in Project-Based Entrepreneurship Education
detail.abstract: Project-based entrepreneurship and management education increasingly integrates digital tools within immersive, industry-linked learning formats. Yet limited empirical evidence examines how students experience the alignment of content, pedagogy, and technology in such environments. Drawing on a TPACK-informed framework, this study investigates relationships among Content Knowledge (CK), Pedagogical Knowledge (PK), Technological Knowledge (TK), Knowledge of Students’ Understanding (KSU), and Perceived Interactive Engagement (PIE) within a joint venture Sino-British transnational higher education university in China. A cross-sectional survey of 131 undergraduate students enrolled in an immersive entrepreneurship programme was analysed using reliability testing, construct suitability assessment, correlational analysis, and subgroup comparisons. Results indicate strong alignment between CK and PK and a particularly strong association between KSU and engagement. While technological knowledge was positively related to other instructional domains, engagement was more strongly associated with instructional responsiveness than technological presence alone. Exploratory subgroup differences suggest that perceptions of technology-integrated pedagogy may be shaped by contextual expectations within transnational settings. By foregrounding student-level evidence, the study reframes technology integration in entrepreneurship education, demonstrating that engagement in digitally supported, industry-linked programmes depend on coherent instructional alignment rather than technological adoption alone.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于TPACK框架，调查了中国一所中英跨国高等教育大学中，创业教育项目中学生对内容知识、教学知识、技术知识、学生理解知识和感知互动参与之间的关系。研究发现，内容与教学知识高度一致，学生理解知识与参与度关联最强，技术整合的有效性更依赖于教学响应性而非单纯技术应用。
AI.research_question: 在沉浸式创业教育项目中，学生如何体验内容知识、教学知识、技术知识、学生理解知识和感知互动参与之间的对齐关系？
AI.motivation: 项目式创业与管理教育越来越多地整合数字工具到沉浸式、行业关联的学习形式中，但关于学生如何体验这些环境中内容、教学和技术的对齐关系的实证证据有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: TPACK框架（技术教学内容知识框架），特别关注内容知识、教学知识、技术知识、学生理解知识和感知互动参与之间的关系。
AI.method: 对131名参与沉浸式创业项目的本科生进行横断面问卷调查，采用信度测试、构念适宜性评估、相关性分析和亚组比较进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 内容知识与教学知识高度一致；2. 学生理解知识与参与度关联最强；3. 技术知识与其他教学领域正相关，但参与度更多与教学响应性相关而非单纯技术存在；4. 亚组差异表明技术整合教学法的感知可能受跨国环境中情境期望影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过突出学生层面的证据，重新构建了创业教育中的技术整合理论，表明数字化支持、行业关联项目的参与度依赖于连贯的教学对齐，而非单纯的技术采用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为创业教育项目设计者提供实践指导：强调教学响应性和学生理解的重要性，而非单纯技术应用；在跨国教育环境中需要考虑情境期望对技术整合感知的影响。

title: Designing a Global Leadership Mindset Program Through Multicultural Sustainability Negotiation Games: A Pre-Assessment–Based Experiential Model

detail.title: Designing a Global Leadership Mindset Program Through Multicultural Sustainability Negotiation Games: A Pre-Assessment–Based Experiential Model
detail.abstract: This study reports the design validation and preliminary pre-post evidence from a 15-hour experiential program utilizing multicultural sustainability negotiation simulations to develop a global leadership mindset. Given that organizations increasingly require leaders who integrate cultural intelligence, sustainability orientation, and collaborative problem-solving, management education needs scalable, design-driven pedagogies to address this complexity. Sixty-six participants from over 25 countries completed comprehensive pre-assessments before participating in three progressively structured sustainability negotiation simulations delivered virtually over five weeks. Following data deduplication and hierarchical matching, 36 participants were retained for paired pre- and post-analysis in a single-group design. Validated measures of Cultural Intelligence, Intercultural Sensitivity, Global Citizenship, and Sustainability Mindset were administered. Findings indicate robust within-subject gains in Cultural Intelligence and Sustainability Mindset; smaller directional increases were observed in Intercultural Sensitivity and Global Citizenship, but these were not significant after multiple-comparison correction. These results suggest that short, intensive experiential programs may more readily influence capability-based constructs than identity-oriented dimensions. However, conclusions remain preliminary due to the absence of a control group and reliance on self-report measures. The study highlights systematic pre-assessment as an active pedagogical tool within intensive experiential learning formats.

AI.tldr: 本研究验证了一个15小时体验式项目的设计，该项目利用多元文化可持续性谈判模拟来培养全球领导力思维。研究发现，短期密集体验式项目能显著提升文化智力和可持续性思维，但对跨文化敏感性和全球公民意识的影响较小。
AI.research_question: 多元文化可持续性谈判模拟体验式项目能否有效培养全球领导力思维？具体而言，该项目对文化智力、跨文化敏感性、全球公民意识和可持续性思维有何影响？
AI.motivation: 组织日益需要具备文化智力、可持续性导向和协作解决问题能力的领导者，而管理教育需要可扩展、设计驱动的教学方法来应对这种复杂性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于文化智力理论、跨文化敏感性理论、全球公民理论和可持续性思维理论，探讨体验式学习如何培养全球领导力能力。
AI.method: 采用单组前后测设计，66名来自25个国家的参与者完成15小时虚拟体验式项目，包含三个渐进式可持续性谈判模拟。经过数据去重和分层匹配，保留36名参与者进行配对分析。使用经过验证的文化智力、跨文化敏感性、全球公民意识和可持续性思维量表。
AI.findings: 研究发现文化智力和可持续性思维有显著的组内提升；跨文化敏感性和全球公民意识有较小的方向性增加，但经过多重比较校正后不显著。这表明短期密集体验式项目更容易影响能力导向的构念而非身份导向的维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 验证了体验式学习对全球领导力发展的有效性；2) 区分了能力导向构念（如文化智力）和身份导向构念（如全球公民意识）的不同影响模式；3) 强调了系统性前评估作为体验式学习中的主动教学工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为管理教育提供了可扩展的全球领导力培养方案；2) 展示了虚拟体验式项目的有效性；3) 为组织培养具备文化智力和可持续性思维的领导者提供了实践指导。

title: Adherence to Hepatitis B Birth Dose Vaccine Recommendations in Two Hospital Systems in Houston
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Adherence to Hepatitis B Birth Dose Vaccine Recommendations in Two Hospital Systems in Houston
detail.abstract: Background: Timely hepatitis B virus (HBV) birth dose vaccination is critical to prevent vertical transmission, particularly when maternal hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) status is positive or unknown. Although universal HBV vaccination has reduced pediatric infections, gaps in maternal screening and variation in adherence to national guidelines for vaccine timing based on maternal HBsAg status persist. We evaluated adherence to national guidelines across maternal risk groups at two hospital systems (HS) and the impact of institutional workflows on timely vaccination.Methods: We conducted a retrospective cohort study of infants ≥2,000 grams born from 2019–2021 at a quaternary hospital system (HS1) and a county hospital system (HS2) to evaluate adherence to national guidelines. Infants were stratified by maternal HBsAg status (positive, unknown, negative). System protocols and workflows were compared.Results: Of 32,952 infants, HS2 had higher adherence to guidelines across maternal risk groups compared to HS1: HBsAg-positive 95.4% vs. 87.1% (p=0.19), unknown 90.8% vs. 17.3% (p<.001), and negative 96.9% vs. 71.2% (p<.001). Despite lower HBsAg rescreening at delivery, HS2 maintained high birth dose vaccination of infants in the unknown group. Infants requiring neonatal intensive care were overrepresented among those with delayed or missed prophylaxis. Workflow differences included breadth of standing delegated orders (SDOs), nurse-led protocols, and hospital location of vaccine storage and administration. Comprehensive SDOs and delivery room administration were associated with timely prophylaxis, particularly among at-risk infants.Conclusion: Adherence to national HBV birth dose recommendations varied between two large HS; this variation may be associated institutional workflow differences.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了两个医院系统对新生儿乙肝疫苗首剂接种指南的依从性差异，发现工作流程设计（特别是全面授权医嘱和产房接种）与及时接种率显著相关。
AI.research_question: 两个大型医院系统对基于母亲HBsAg状态的乙肝疫苗首剂接种指南依从性如何？机构工作流程差异如何影响及时接种率？
AI.motivation: 尽管普遍接种已减少儿童感染，但母亲筛查不足和基于母亲HBsAg状态的疫苗接种时机指南依从性存在差异，需要评估机构工作流程对及时接种的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗质量改进理论、系统工作流程优化理论、疫苗接种依从性影响因素理论
AI.method: 回顾性队列研究，分析2019-2021年两个医院系统（四级医院系统HS1和县医院系统HS2）32,952名婴儿数据，按母亲HBsAg状态分层，比较系统协议和工作流程。
AI.findings: HS2在所有母亲风险组中指南依从性均高于HS1：HBsAg阳性95.4% vs 87.1%，未知90.8% vs 17.3%，阴性96.9% vs 71.2%。全面授权医嘱和产房接种与及时预防相关，特别是高风险婴儿。需要新生儿重症监护的婴儿延迟或错过预防的比例过高。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了机构工作流程设计对疫苗接种指南依从性的关键影响，为医疗系统优化提供了理论框架，强调了系统化协议在提高医疗质量中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了提高乙肝疫苗首剂及时接种率的关键工作流程要素：全面授权医嘱、护士主导协议、产房疫苗储存和接种。为医院系统改进疫苗接种流程提供了具体可操作的改进方向。

title: Privacy-Preserving Graph Similarity Search Based on Secure Multi-party Computation
affiliations: Qingdao University, Qingdao University, Qingdao University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Shandong University, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Privacy-Preserving Graph Similarity Search Based on Secure Multi-party Computation
detail.abstract: Graph similarity search, which aims to retrieve all graphs similar to a given query graph from a graph database, plays a crucial role in various domains such as social network analysis and drug discovery. With the growing scale of graph data and limited local computational resources, outsourcing graph similarity search to the cloud has become a practical trend. However, outsourcing computation raises significant privacy concerns, as sensitive information may be exposed to untrusted cloud servers. This has motivated the development of privacy-preserving solutions, with PrigSim [1] being the most advanced system to date. Nevertheless, it suffers from limitations in both efficiency and security. On the efficiency side, PrigSim relies on an inefficient lower bound estimation method, resulting in slow query performance. On the security side, the system leaks the identities of the returned graphs and the number of results. In this paper, we propose a novel privacy-preserving graph similarity search framework based on secure multi-party computation (MPC) that addresses these limitations. Specifically, we design an efficient lower bound computation protocol that provides tighter bounds while preserving privacy, significantly improving query performance. In addition, we introduce a comprehensive output privacy enhancement mechanism that conceals all output-related information. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that our proposed scheme outperforms PrigSim under various settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于安全多方计算（MPC）的新型隐私保护图相似性搜索框架，解决了现有系统PrigSim在效率和安全性方面的局限性。通过设计高效的隐私保护下界计算协议和全面的输出隐私增强机制，显著提升了查询性能并隐藏了所有输出相关信息。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个既高效又安全的隐私保护图相似性搜索框架，以解决现有系统在查询性能和输出隐私泄露方面的问题？
AI.motivation: 随着图数据规模的增大和本地计算资源的限制，将图相似性搜索外包到云端已成为趋势，但这引发了严重的隐私问题。现有最先进的隐私保护系统PrigSim存在效率和安全性两方面的局限性：效率方面依赖低效的下界估计方法导致查询速度慢；安全性方面会泄露返回图的身份和结果数量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于安全多方计算（MPC）的理论框架，结合图相似性搜索算法和隐私保护计算理论。
AI.method: 1. 设计高效的隐私保护下界计算协议，提供更紧密的下界估计；2. 引入全面的输出隐私增强机制，隐藏所有输出相关信息；3. 基于安全多方计算（MPC）构建完整的隐私保护图相似性搜索框架。
AI.findings: 实验评估表明，在不同设置下，本文提出的方案在性能上优于PrigSim系统，同时提供了更强的隐私保护。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了基于MPC的隐私保护图相似性搜索理论框架；2. 设计了高效的隐私保护下界计算协议；3. 建立了全面的输出隐私保护理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了比PrigSim更高效的隐私保护图相似性搜索系统；2. 解决了实际应用中输出信息泄露的安全问题；3. 为社交网络分析、药物发现等领域的隐私保护图搜索提供了实用解决方案。

detail.title: Not Footnotes Anymore: Women Redefining Academic Leadership
detail.abstract: The modern world has been a pivotal witness to billions of women serving ardently across various sectors of the economy, including industry, corporate, banking, entrepreneurship, healthcare, and education. Women are also making remarkable contributions, leaving an indelible mark as academic leaders and administrators in higher education institutions (HEIs). This study aimed to examine the challenges women leaders face in their day-to-day work and explore the opportunities and prospects for them in HEIs. The researchers conducted qualitative case study research using one-to-one interviews with twelve women academic leaders (seasoned administrators) in order to gain a comprehensive understanding of the first-hand experience(s) in academia at the University of Allahabad and its constituent colleges by conducting a thematic analysis to analyze the qualitative data. The researchers identified the idiosyncratic realities of women’s positions in academic leadership, highlighting how women overcome gender stereotypes and advance to positions of authority. This paper includes barriers, prospects, and perceptions of women’s leadership in different HEIs.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过质性案例研究，探讨了高等教育机构中女性学术领导者面临的挑战、机遇和前景，特别关注她们如何克服性别刻板印象并晋升到权威职位。
AI.research_question: 高等教育机构中女性领导者面临哪些日常工作中的挑战？她们在高等教育机构中有哪些机遇和前景？
AI.motivation: 现代社会中女性在各个经济领域做出了重要贡献，包括高等教育机构中的学术领导和行政管理。然而，女性在高等教育领导职位中面临的独特挑战和机遇需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别领导力理论、组织行为学中的性别刻板印象理论、高等教育管理理论
AI.method: 质性案例研究，采用一对一访谈法，对12名女性学术领导者（资深行政人员）进行访谈，通过主题分析处理质性数据
AI.findings: 识别了女性在学术领导职位中的独特现实情况，揭示了女性如何克服性别刻板印象并晋升到权威职位，包括面临的障碍、发展前景和不同高等教育机构中对女性领导力的认知
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了高等教育中女性领导力理论，提供了性别刻板印象克服机制的理论解释，扩展了学术领导力发展理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为高等教育机构制定支持女性领导力发展的政策提供依据，为女性学术领导者提供职业发展指导，促进高等教育机构的性别平等和多元化领导
